roles.textDescription: The credential service. Speaks to the plugin and reads nothing else.
Every gateway. Subscribing is granted across spBv1.0/ so wildcard subscriptions succeed; what is delivered is decided by the gateway's own role, plus the primary-host STATE topics here.

The ingestion daemon: reads every Sparkplug topic, publishes only rebirth NCMDs, and is the only writer of the Directory and the Unified Namespace. TWO of its grants are not in this file, because both are named by the deployment rather than by this repository and are injected at reconcile time: its write on spBv1.0/STATE/<host_id> from PRIMARY_HOST_ID, and the Directory subtree from DIRECTORY_MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX, which is derived from the site's Sparkplug group.
The i3X server: reads the whole Sparkplug namespace and publishes nothing. It reads the Directory from the database over PostgREST, not from the broker, so it holds no Directory grant here.
The health probes and the metrics exporter: $SYS only.
